enable_lie_group_checks: use the enable_checks context manager to temporarily enable Lie group validation checks
get_check_context: get the current Lie group check context state via the get_context class method
set_check_context: set the Lie group check context to True or False using the set_context class method
run_checks_base: run the checks_base function to validate a tensor against a custom check implementation
disable_checks_for_vmap: disable Lie group checks before running vmap operations to avoid RuntimeError on batched tensors
